description: This file is a Polymer mini HTML file that includes embedded JavaScript defining Polymer base features, such as template handling, DOM manipulation, and custom element lifecycle methods. It also imports other Polymer components.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi
classes.description: A DOM API shim providing uniform access to DOM features and custom element behaviors, including DOM manipulation, event handling, and shadow DOM distribution.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.Event
classes.description: A wrapper for DOM events providing cross-browser properties for event targets and paths.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.ClassList
classes.description: A class list wrapper that provides methods to manipulate element classes with distribution updates.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.EffectiveNodesObserver
classes.description: An observer for effective DOM nodes, tracking changes and distribution, with support for shadow DOM if enabled.

classes.name: Polymer.DomApi.DistributedNodesObserver
classes.description: An observer specifically for distributed nodes in shadow DOM or content distribution, extending EffectiveNodesObserver.

methods.name: _prepTemplate
methods.description: Prepares the template by importing and validating its content, ensuring it is suitable for instantiation.

methods.name: instanceTemplate
methods.description: Creates a document fragment instance from a given template.

methods.name: _addFeature
methods.description: Registers or adds a feature (set of methods/properties) to the Polymer base system.

methods.name: distributeContent
methods.description: Distributes child nodes into insertion points within shadow DOM, supporting custom content distribution.

methods.name: notifyObserver
methods.description: Notifies observers about DOM changes in the node or its children.

calls: Native DOM methods such as insertBefore, removeChild, cloneNode, importNode
